description: This source file contains functional tests for the AccountController's SignIn functionality in an ASP.NET Core web application, using xUnit as the testing framework. It includes tests for rendering the login page, verifying request tokens, and conducting login and profile update operations.

classes.name: AccountControllerSignIn
classes.description: A test class for AccountController SignIn actions, initializing an HTTP client and containing multiple test methods for login-related functionalities.

methods.name: ReturnsSignInScreenOnGet
methods.description: Tests that a GET request to the login endpoint returns a page containing the expected email.

methods.name: RegexMatchesValidRequestVerificationToken
methods.description: Validates that the regex correctly extracts the hidden request verification token from an HTML input string.

methods.name: ReturnsFormWithRequestVerificationToken
methods.description: Checks that the login page includes a valid request verification token.

methods.name: ReturnsSuccessfulSignInOnPostWithValidCredentials
methods.description: Simulates a login POST request with valid credentials and confirms redirect to the home page.

methods.name: UpdatePhoneNumberProfile
methods.description: Logs in a user, navigates to the profile page, updates the phone number field, and verifies the change.
